structures.name: SubscriptionSetParams
structures.doc: The sessions this connection wants live updates for.

structures.name: AuthLoginOutcomeFailed
structures.doc: Login failed without changing durable credentials.

structures.name: AuthLoginOutcomeSucceeded
structures.doc: Login completed successfully and credentials were durably stored.

structures.name: AuthLoginResultBrowser
structures.doc: Browser authorization details returned only to the requesting connection.

structures.name: AuthLoginResultDeviceCode
structures.doc: Device authorization details returned only to the requesting connection.

structures.name: AuthLoginSummary
structures.doc: Public locator for one daemon-owned login attempt. It contains no OAuth secret.

structures.name: AuthProvider
structures.doc: Public authentication state and capabilities for one provider.

structures.name: AuthSetApiKeyParams
structures.doc: Write-only params for `auth.set_api_key`. The key is never returned or retained by wire state.

structures.name: AuthSetApiKeyResult
structures.doc: Result of staging an API-key replacement.

structures.name: DirEntry
structures.doc: A single filesystem entry in a browse listing.

fields.name: is_git_repo
fields.doc: Whether this directory is itself a git repo.

structures.name: GitInfo
structures.doc: Git status for a workspace root, when it is a repo.

fields.name: dirty
fields.doc: Whether the working tree has uncommitted changes.

structures.name: SkillRef
structures.doc: A named skill invocation with its rendered arguments.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Page size; omitted means daemon default.

fields.name: cursor
fields.doc: Opaque continuation within the same directory.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Parent directory path; null at the filesystem root.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.doc: Opaque continuation; required null on the final page.

fields.name: git
fields.doc: Git status; null when the root is not a repo.

fields.name: last_used_model
fields.doc: Last model used in this workspace; null if never run.

structures.name: WorkspaceRef
structures.doc: Params naming a workspace and nothing else.

fields.name: related_job_ids
fields.doc: Cron jobs that referenced the removed workspace.

structures.name: CatalogListResultFull
structures.doc: Client's revision was stale or absent; full catalog included.

structures.name: CatalogListResultUnchanged
structures.doc: Client's revision is current; no catalog data included.

structures.name: ModelCost
structures.doc: United States dollars per million tokens.

structures.name: ModelInfo
structures.doc: Closed projection of a provider model record. Non-owning.

structures.name: SkippedProvider
structures.doc: Providers skipped during catalog load. Non-owning.

structures.name: ActivityStateBuilding
structures.doc: Runtime is being built as the first phase of a run.

structures.name: CronJobSpec
structures.doc: Full spec for a cron job.

structures.name: CronPatch
structures.doc: Optional-field patch applied to an existing cron job.

structures.name: ActiveDraft
structures.doc: In-flight assistant draft, resent on resync. Non-owning.

structures.name: MessageError
structures.doc: Structured error on an assistant message with `finish: "error"`. Non-owning.

structures.name: MessageTime
structures.doc: Creation/completion timestamps on an assistant message.

structures.name: PartDelta
structures.doc: Incremental text or reasoning bytes for a draft.

structures.name: RedactedReasoningPart
structures.doc: Opaque safety-redacted model reasoning payload. Non-owning.

structures.name: TokenUsage
structures.doc: Token accounting for one assistant message.

structures.name: TurnProvenance
structures.doc: Provider that produced an assistant turn. Non-owning.

structures.name: CreatedTime
structures.doc: Creation timestamp for a user or compaction message.

structures.name: InitializeResult
structures.doc: Result of the `initialize` request: the coarse daemon snapshot.

structures.name: Notice
structures.doc: Daemon diagnostic notice broadcast to all connections. Non-owning.

structures.name: QueuedInput
structures.doc: A queued input waiting behind an active turn.

structures.name: PermissionDecisionRule
structures.doc: Decided by a matched persisted rule.

structures.name: PermissionDecisionUser
structures.doc: Decided by a user selecting an option.

structures.name: PermissionOption
structures.doc: One option the daemon proposes for a permission request.

structures.name: PermissionRule
structures.doc: A remembered "allow always" answer, scoped to a workspace.

structures.name: PermissionState
structures.doc: Local-only lifecycle data folded into tool state. Never a broadcast.

structures.name: RunCanceledTiming
structures.doc: Cancellation timing; an accepted queued run may never start.

structures.name: RunOutcomeCanceled
structures.doc: A run canceled by the user or daemon. Its timing rides the terminal envelope.

structures.name: RunOutcomeCompacted
structures.doc: A manual compaction that produced a summary.

structures.name: RunOutcomeFailed
structures.doc: A run that failed after daemon retry policy was exhausted.

structures.name: RunOutcomeSkipped
structures.doc: A manual compaction that did nothing.

structures.name: RunOutcomeTurn
structures.doc: A completed turn: it stopped for a stop reason after some round trips.

structures.name: SessionDeltasShedData
structures.doc: Advisory notice that this connection's live deltas were shed.

structures.name: SessionListItem
structures.doc: Compact session row for `session.list` and session broadcasts. Non-owning.

structures.name: SessionPatch
structures.doc: Missing field means no change. The system prompt is snapshotted at creation and is not patchable. Non-owning.

structures.name: SessionPopulationChildren
structures.doc: Immediate persistent children of one session.

structures.name: SessionPopulationJobRuns
structures.doc: Sessions created by one cron job.

structures.name: SessionPopulationTopLevel
structures.doc: User-facing conversations: root sessions and forks.

structures.name: SessionResult
structures.doc: Result of session creation, forking, or patching.

structures.name: SessionResyncResult
structures.doc: Full session snapshot for reconnection. Non-owning.

structures.name: DiffFile
structures.doc: One file in a diff view.

structures.name: DiffHunk
structures.doc: One hunk of a unified diff.

unions.name: SessionScope
unions.doc: Workspace scope searched by `session.list`.

unions.name: ContentPart
unions.doc: One part of a message's content.

unions.name: MediaSource
unions.doc: Where media bytes live.

unions.name: AuthLoginOutcome
unions.doc: Terminal outcome for a daemon-owned login attempt.

unions.name: AuthLoginResult
unions.doc: Result of `auth.login`, tagged by the mechanism actually started.

unions.name: CatalogListResult
unions.doc: Result of catalog.list: unchanged since `since_rev`, or a full catalog snapshot.

unions.name: SkipReason
unions.doc: Reason a provider was skipped.

unions.name: ActivityState
unions.doc: Session activity state; locator fields let clients detect drift and resync.

unions.name: CronSchedule
unions.doc: A cron schedule: recurring or one-shot. Non-owning.

unions.name: Input
unions.doc: A unit of user input: either raw content or a skill invocation. Non-owning.

unions.name: AssistantPart
unions.doc: One element of an assistant message `content[]`. Non-owning.

unions.name: Message
unions.doc: A transcript message. Non-owning.

unions.name: PermissionDecision
unions.doc: Who answered a permission request, and how. Non-owning.

unions.name: RunOutcome
unions.doc: Terminal outcome of a run, discriminated by `type`.

unions.name: SessionOrigin
unions.doc: How a session was created.

unions.name: SessionPopulation
unions.doc: Session relationship population searched by session.list.

unions.name: SessionSendInputResult
unions.doc: Result of `session.send_input`: started immediately or queued behind an active turn.

unions.name: ToolState
unions.doc: Lifecycle state of a tool part. Non-owning.

unions.name: View
unions.doc: Display-only rendering hint. Frontends may render natively or ignore. Non-owning.

unions.name: RequestParams
unions.doc: Client request parameter envelope.

unions.name: ResponseResult
unions.doc: Server response result envelope.

unions.name: BroadcastData
unions.doc: Server broadcast data envelope.

unions.name: Response
unions.doc: RPC response envelope.

enumerations.name: ErrorCode
enumerations.doc: Numeric JSON-RPC and yuke error code.

enumerations.name: CronMissedPolicy
enumerations.doc: Policy for a missed cron schedule.

enumerations.name: DeniedBy
enumerations.doc: Authority that decided a permission request.
